title: Voltas 190L Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator
description: Direct cool single door refrigerator with insulated capillary technology that holds cooling for hours during a power cut.

faqs.question: Does the price include installation?
faqs.answer: Yes — standard installation within city limits is included and handled by our own team.

faqs.question: What is the delivery time?
faqs.answer: Two to four business days for most addresses. We confirm the date with you directly.

faqs.question: Is the warranty the manufacturer's?
faqs.answer: Yes. Warranty is registered in your name and serviced through the brand's authorised network.
